interest: Highlights Japanese business pushback against Dodge Line deflation alongside detailed SCAP stabilization plans for occupied Okinawa.
overview: This file documents economic conditions, stabilization efforts, and foreign trade policies in occupied Japan and the Ryukyu Islands during December 1949. Key materials include extensive Japanese business memoranda from the Japan Management Association criticizing the deflationary impact of the Dodge Line and proposing revisions to the Shoup tax reforms, alongside State Department and SCAP reporting on foreign trade arrangements, labor wage disputes, precious metals disposal, and comprehensive economic stabilization recommendations for Okinawa.
